verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, renumbers the survivors in original order via `renumber = {old: new for new, old in enumerate(kept)}` (old 3→2, 7→5, 11→8, 15→11, as specified), builds a fresh dict so no rename can collide, and passes non-block tensors (`model.embed_tokens.weight`, `lm_head.weight`) through untouched with values, shapes and dtypes preserved. Both required checks run before any write — the layer-index set must equal `{0..11}` (which rules out any residual block 12–15 and enforces exactly 12 blocks) and the total must be exactly 86 tensors — so a failure aborts with a non-zero exit and leaves `out/T1/model.safetensors` unwritten. The output is the single required file at the required path.
